devdoc.author: Index Coop Contract for issuing and redeeming a leveraged Set Token Supports all standard (1 collateral / 1 debt token) leveraged tokens on either morpho or aave leveragemodule Both the collateral as well as the debt token have to be available for flashloan from morpho and be tradeable against each other via one of the whitelisted swap target contracts

params._isAave: Boolean indicating wether leverage token is based on aave leverage module
params._setToken: Address of the SetToken being initialized

params._token: Address of the token which needs approval

params._tokens: Addresses of the tokens which need approval

params._aaveLeverageModule: AaveLeverageModule to sync before every issuance / redemption
params._debtIssuanceModule: DebtIssuanceModule used to issue and redeem tokens
params._morpho: Morpho contract to call for flashloan
params._morphoLeverageModule: MorphoLeverageModule to sync before every issuance / redemption
params._setController: SetToken controller used to verify a given token is a set
params._swapTarget: Address of the 0x router to use for swaps
params._weth: WETH contract to deposit and withdraw eth

params._isAave: Boolean indicating wether given leveraged token is based on aave leverage module (or morpho)
params._isIssuance: Boolean indicating if the SetToken is to be issued or redeemed
params._setAmount: Amount of SetTokens to issue / redeem
params._setToken: Address of the SetToken to be issued / redeemed

returns._0: Struct containing the collateral / debt token addresses and amounts

params._isAave: Boolean indicating wether given token is based on aave or morpho leverage module
params._maxAmountInputToken: Maximum amount of input token to spend
params._swapDataDebtForCollateral: Data (token addresses and fee levels) to describe the swap path from Debt to collateral token
params._swapDataInputToken: Data (token addresses and fee levels) to describe the swap path from input to collateral token

params._isAave: Boolean indicating wether given token is based on aave or morpho leverage module
params._swapDataDebtForCollateral: Data (token addresses and fee levels) to describe the swap path from Debt to collateral token
params._swapDataInputToken: Data (token addresses and fee levels) to describe the swap path from eth to collateral token

params.assets: Amount of tokens loaned / to be repayed
params.data: Encoded data containing the original sender and leveraged token data

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params._isAave: Boolean indicating wether given token is based on aave or morpho leverage module
params._minAmountOutputToken: Minimum amount of output token to send to the user
params._outputToken: Address of the ERC20 token to send to the user
params._swapDataCollateralForDebt: Data (token path and fee levels) describing the swap from Collateral Token to Debt Token
params._swapDataOutputToken: Data (token path and fee levels) describing the swap from Collateral Token to Output token

params._isAave: Boolean indicating wether given token is based on aave or morpho leverage module
params._minAmountOutputToken: Minimum amount of ETH to send to the user
params._swapDataCollateralForDebt: Data (token path and fee levels) describing the swap from Collateral Token to Debt Token
params._swapDataOutputToken: Data (token path and fee levels) describing the swap from Collateral Token to Eth

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._isAllowed: Boolean indicating wether given contract should be included in the whitelist
params._swapTarget: Settlement contract to add/remove from whitelist

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._token: Token to be withdrawn from the contract balance

approveSetToken(address,bool).notice: Runs all the necessary approval functions required before issuing or redeeming a SetToken. This function need to be called only once before the first time this smart contract is used on any particular SetToken.

approveToken(address).notice: Runs all the necessary approval functions required for a given ERC20 token. This function can be called when a new token is added to a SetToken during a rebalance.

approveTokens(address[]).notice: Runs all the necessary approval functions required for a list of ERC20 tokens.

getLeveragedTokenData(address,uint256,bo.notice: Returns the collateral / debt token addresses and amounts for a leveraged index

issueExactSetFromERC20(address,uint256,a.notice: Trigger issuance of set token paying with any arbitrary ERC20 token

issueExactSetFromETH(address,uint256,(ad.notice: Trigger issuance of set token paying with Eth

onMorphoFlashLoan(uint256,bytes).notice: Callback function called by Morpho after flashloan has been requested

redeemExactSetForERC20(address,uint256,a.notice: Trigger redemption of set token to pay the user with an arbitrary ERC20

redeemExactSetForETH(address,uint256,uin.notice: Trigger redemption of set token to pay the user with Eth

setSwapTargetWhitelist(address,bool).notice: Adds or removes a given swapTarget from the whitelist OWNER ONLY

withdrawToken(address).notice: Withdraws stranded tokens from the contracts balance OWNER ONLY
